items.title: Cade Klubnik in for Jets, Geno Smith being evaluated for a concussion
items.text: The Jets have turned to Cade Klubnik at quarterback to start the second half of Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.title: Trent McDuffie active for Rams-Cardinals

items.title: Kirk Cousins, Vikings dominate, lead 17-0 at halftime
items.text: Kirk Cousins is back, and so are the Vikings.

items.title: Game between Bill Belichick's UNC and Louisville ends in a brawl
items.text: Saturday's not alright for fighting.

items.title: Bill Belichick on Louisville-UNC brawl: "That's not what we're here for"
items.text: Saturday's game between Louisville and North Carolina ended in a brawl, sparked apparently by the Tar Heels being a little too aggressive in defending a victory-formation play.

items.title: Thomas Booker, Dont'e Thornton are inactive for the Raiders
items.text: The Raiders had a pair of players listed as questionable on their final injury report of the week and neither of them will be in the lineup for Fernando Mendoza's first NFL start.

items.title: Josh Downs scores first TD with Chiefs, Kansas City leads Atlanta 14-3 at halftime
items.text: Josh Downs is making an impact in his Kansas City debut.

items.title: Jets cut Bills lead to 10-6 before halftime
items.text: The Bills are trying to stay unbeaten on the road against the Jets on Sunday and they have moved into halftime with a lead.

items.title: More tests coming for Drake Maye, after suffering ankle injury vs. Lions
items.text: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye suffered an ankle injury at the end of the opening drive of Sunday's game against the Lions in Germany.

items.title: Panthers take 7-0 lead into halftime in New Orleans
items.text: The Panthers got on the board midway through the second quarter against the Saints and those remained the only points of the first half in New Orleans.

items.title: Colts lead Dolphins 14-7 at halftime
items.text: Laquon Treadwell caught a 7-yard touchdown pass from Daniel Jones with 39 seconds left in the first half, giving the Colts a 14-7 lead over the Dolphins at halftime.

items.title: Texans lead Browns 17-10 at halftime
items.text: The Texans got out to a 17-0 lead in Cleveland, but the Browns have made it a game with 10 straight points.

items.title: Aidan Hutchinson reportedly has "significant" knee injury
items.text: Reports conflict on whether it's known to be season-ending.

items.title: Vikings lead Packers 17-0 after Kirk Cousins' INT overturned by replay
items.text: Kirk Cousins nearly had his first interception since his return to the Vikings.

items.title: Chuba Hubbard comes through on fourth down to put Panthers up 7-0
items.text: Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard is on his way to a big day in New Orleans.

items.title: Travis Kelce questionable to return with ankle injury
items.text: Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce is questionable to return to Sunday’s game against the Falcons with an ankle injury.

items.title: Dan Campbell on Aidan Hutchinson: "We'll know more when we get back in the States"
items.text: The Lions got their seventh win of the season on Sunday, 35-10 over the Patriots in Germany.

items.title: Kirk Cousins' TD pass gives Vikings 10-0 lead on Packers
items.text: Kirk Cousins threw his first touchdown pass for the Vikings since an Oct. 29, 2023, game against the Packers.

items.title: Josh Allen's 10th rushing TD of season puts Bills up 7-0
items.text: Bills quarterback Josh Allen has given his team an early lead at MetLife Stadium.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza hopes to improve poor debuts by QBs taken No. 1 overall
items.text: With former Raiders starting quarterback Kirk Cousins currently playing for the Vikings, rookie Fernando Mendoza — the first overall pick in the draft — will make his first career start on Sunday against the Seahawks.

items.title: Parker Washington TD catch gives Jacksonville early lead in Tennessee
items.text: Jaguars wide receiver Parker Washington is making plays, as usual.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes moves past Peyton Manning for most TDs in first 10 seasons
items.text: Patrick Mahomes has accomplished another career milestone, giving the Chiefs an early lead in the process.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs leads the way as Lions blow past Patriots in Germany
items.text: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye got injured on the first possession, and New England wasn't competitive after that.

items.title: Aaron Glenn could become sixth coach to start 0-9 in division
items.text: Jets coach Aaron Glenn has a 5-21 record during his one-and-a-half-year tenure with the team.

items.title: Panthers and Saints battle for fourth win — and NFC South lead
items.text: Sunday begins with the Panthers and Saints at 3-5, and the Falcons and Buccaneers at 3-6.
